UPDATED 9/3: the two Hybrids no longer normalize to the same string -- 'LG03-LG05' was renamed 'LG03' -- so the slugs were realigned to the real names (lg05 -> lg03, lg05-emoji -> lg05) and leagues/ renamed with them. Old slug -> new slug: lg05 -> lg03, lg05-emoji -> lg05. DECISIONS.md, CHANGELOG.md and DEPENDENCIES.md keep the OLD names on purpose: they are history and describe the state at the time.
_keepers_note: Only leagues with rules that are NOT in the Sleeper API need an entry in data/keepers.json. lg02 and lg06 have none and are absent from it; every reader does .get(lid) or {}, so absence is safe and means room_shave 0.

lg06.note: THE IDP LEAGUE. ROADMAP said 'the sixth league does not exist yet -- IDP support is built and tested and waiting. Nothing to do until there is a league id.' It has one, and it is pre-draft with no date set. 10 teams, the only league that is not 12 or 14. Carries K but NO team DEF -- individual defenders instead, so every pts_allow_* and team sack/int rule is zeroed out.
lg06.scoring_warning: Scoring is unlike anything else in the portfolio and every intuition from the other five leagues is wrong here. Touchdowns are 10 points, not 6. Passing yards 0.05, not 0.04. Full 1.0 PPR. Turnovers -5, not -2. Yardage bonuses at 100/200 rushing and receiving and 300/400 passing. Most importantly it pays 0.5 PER ATTEMPT on both pass and rush -- volume scoring, which nothing else he plays has, and which rewards high-attempt players independent of efficiency. A 600-attempt quarterback banks 300 points before a single yard. IDP pays 10 for a sack, an interception or a defensive TD, 2 for a pass defensed, 1 per tackle and assist, plus 10 for a 10-tackle game.
